title: Florida House, District 38
what_it_does: Represents District 38 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat: Republican Rep. David Smith is term-limited. Republicans Emily Duda Buckley and Marcus Hyatt met in the Aug. 18 Republican primary; the winner faces Democrat Michelle DeJesus on Nov. 3. The primary result could not be verified.
verified_ballot_note: Oviedo Community News (June 17, 2026) reported the HD 38 field: Republicans Emily Duda Buckley (of Duda Farm Fresh Foods, Oviedo) and Marcus Hyatt in the primary, with the winner facing Democrat Michelle DeJesus in November (https://oviedocommunitynews.org/2026/06/17/whos-on-the-seminole-county-primary-ballot-for-2026/). The Aug. 18 primary winner was not found in search snippets; both Republicans are listed below pending verification. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.background: Republican candidate for HD 38 associated with Duda Farm Fresh Foods Inc. in Oviedo; ran in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary against Marcus Hyatt (result unverified).
